reason: Documentation, internal only. Runbook section 6b documents `nora measure participation`, which shipped with the four ambient-path measures and had no operator entry: how to run it in the container, why it exists (today the verdict is the measurement, and a refusal is indistinguishable from health in every log the system keeps), that the ceiling printed under each number must be read with it, and that n/a is not zero. Also documents the two-step recipe for the refusal-side measures, whose times come from a Prometheus counter produced by a host-side script rather than from a durable row, and why the command refuses a refusal file that does not span the window asked for. Nothing a member of a room can observe.
